fields.value: Approximately 123 bpm (conditional mean-interval estimate). Mostly similar spacings, with a shorter interval and subsequent longer spacing in the middle. Tall similar upright spikes at mostly similar gaps with one shorter gap near middle; rounded intercomplex humps. The shorter interval supports comparing premature-beat patterns, but does not select an atrial, junctional or ventricular origin. A premature atrial comparison specifically requires a demonstrably early atrial wave differing from the background atrial waves, a resolved atrial-to-ventricular sequence and the course interval criteria; these are not established here. PR remains withheld. The selected QRS uncertainty envelope crosses 0.12 s and does not establish a narrow/wide class.
